description: This Java class `MatriculaService` provides services related to course registration (matricula) in an educational platform. It handles creating new enrolments, checking for existing enrolments, and saving new matricula objects using Spring repositories.

classes.name: MatriculaService
classes.description: A service class managing course enrollment functionalities, including creating and validating matriculas, in a Spring-based Java application.

methods.name: createMatricula
methods.description: Creates a new matricula (enrollment) for a given course ID and username, throwing an exception if the user is already enrolled.
